what: Auto-update on MCP server start now covers ALL components: hooks (.claude/settings.json), MCP config (.mcp.json), rules files (if exist), directory structure (.aide/memories/*), .gitignore entries, and git post-checkout hook. Matches --force coverage exactly. Both merge, neither resets user config. Config (.aide/config.json) is not touched by either — future --reset flag for factory defaults if needed. Only difference: auto-update skips rules if they don't exist (un-init'd projects), --force always writes them.
why: User wanted auto-update to cover all components, not just hooks. Directory structure and .gitignore were missing — new version could add a new memory layer directory and users wouldn't get it without re-running init.
